sv.title: Bil körde in i fasad – minst en skadad
sv.summary: En bil har kört in en glasfasad på Östermalm mitt i Stockholm och minst en person har skadats, rapporterar flera medier.

en.title: Car crashes into façade – at least one injured
en.summary: A car has crashed into a glass façade in Östermalm in central Stockholm and at least one person has been injured, several media outlets report.
